footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net income: includes a $5.7M income tax benefit, $73.8M from discontinued operations.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 67.9% to $488K in 2025. The operating loss widened to $46.7M from $40.3M.
Net income fell 34.6% to $34.9M, or $0.76 per share. Operating cash flow was $168M and free cash flow $168M, versus $241M; Tiptree returned $9.1M through dividends.
sources: Tiptree Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
